newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products dip, while gas oil plunges.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products dip, while gas oil plunges.

text.p: NWE gas oil sank by more than $5 a tonne on Friday as IPE futures lost most of Thursday's gains, while other products merely dipped, dealers said.
Heating oil barge premiums were broadly unchanged. Prompt was offered at IPE Oct +$8.50 fob ARA, but prices dropped with underlying futures down more than $5 a tonne.
Dealers reported little physical activity as both buyers and sellers were nervous amid the volatile futures. Second half October offers were notionally at Oct +$2 fob ARA.
High sulphur fuel oil traded just once at $113 fob ARA. Offers for end Sept, early Oct were also around that level.
That was a dip of $1 from Thursday.
Gasoline prices dipped $2/$3 a tonne as futures headed down.
Traders said there was no sign of end-user demand and take-up for shipment to the U.S. had died down. An October swap traded at $206 fob ARA.
